notes: ACCOUNTING BASIS: Ritchie Bros. was a Foreign Private Issuer filing 40-F/6-K and reported under IFRS (as issued by the IASB) for all of 2013-2014 (annual 40-F FS, interim 6-K FS, press releases). It lost FPI status at 30-Jun-2015 and the FY2015 10-K (acc. 0001279569-16-002775) is the first US GAAP filing, with FY2014/FY2013 retrospectively restated to US GAAP.

CHOSEN BASIS PER PERIOD: Quarters Q1/13-Q4/14 'is' = IFRS as reported in the latest IFRS filing covering them (2013 quarters from the 2014 interim 6-Ks comparatives incl. NCI split; 2014 quarters from the 2015 interim 6-K Ex.99.2 comparatives, which are identical to the original 2014 filings). No full US GAAP quarterly IS exists for 2013 quarters or Q1-Q3/14; the 10-K note 28 gives US GAAP revenue / operating income / NI / NI to stockholders / EPS for Q1-Q4/14 -> stored as 'is_usgaap' (Q4/14 has a full US GAAP three-month IS from the Q4/15 8-K release Ex.99.1). Annual '2013'/'2014' 'is' and 'cf' = US GAAP recast (10-K); IFRS as-reported versions kept in 'is_ifrs'/'cf_ifrs'/'adj_ni_ifrs'/'adj_ebitda_ifrs'. THEREFORE quarterly 'is' (IFRS) sums tie to 'is_ifrs' (verified line by line), NOT to the annual US GAAP 'is'.

IFRS vs US GAAP differences (FY): revenue, direct expenses, SG&A, D&A and pre-tax income are identical. Income tax differs (2014: IFRS 35.966 vs US GAAP 36.475; 2013: 40.129 vs 40.310) so NI differs (2014 NI to parent 91.490 IFRS vs 90.981 US GAAP; 2013 93.825 vs 93.644); diluted shares 2014 107.660 vs 107.655, 2013 107.049 vs 107.155; 2013 diluted EPS 0.88 IFRS vs 0.87 US GAAP. Quarterly 2014 NI (US GAAP vs IFRS): Q1 13.435 vs 14.518, Q2 37.536 vs 39.135, Q3 9.643 vs 9.603, Q4 31.949 vs 29.816. Balance sheet: US GAAP separates restricted cash (93.274 at 31-Dec-14) from cash (IFRS cash 233.089 included it); US GAAP PP&E 580.7 vs IFRS 577.4 (+investment property 3.3 folded into PP&E); US GAAP DTA 9.9/DTL 34.1 vs IFRS 1.3/24.5; US GAAP shows contingently redeemable NCI (RBFS 49%) as temporary equity 17.287 (2013: 8.303) with redemption-value changes charged to retained earnings (2014 -7.512, 2013 -3.998; not included in EPS); AOCI under US GAAP was +18.9 at Dec-13 vs IFRS FX reserve -12.9 (IFRS 1 CTA reset). US GAAP CF CFO 171.4 (2014)/146.6 (2013) vs IFRS 149.5/188.0 because restricted-cash movements are in operating cash flow under US GAAP and cash basis excludes restricted cash; US GAAP CF also classifies 2014 debt repayments differently (LTD repaid 58.4 vs IFRS 28.1 LT + net ST).

PRESENTATION (line mapping): IFRS IS presented Revenues, Direct expenses, SG&A (incl. D&A; split given in notes/releases) -> 'Earnings from operations' (stored as op_income), with FX gain/loss, gain on disposition of PP&E, impairment loss (Q3/14 Narita 8.084) and 'Other' BELOW earnings from operations in 'Other income (expense)', then finance income/costs (stored as interest_income/interest_exp). Validation for IFRS periods: op_income + fx + gain_disp_ppe - impairment + other_income + interest_income - interest_exp = pretax. US GAAP (10-K) RECLASSIFIED gain on disposition of PP&E, impairment and FX gain/loss INTO operating income, renamed direct expenses 'Direct expenses, excluding depreciation and amortization' (cost_services) and shows D&A as a separate line (so US GAAP op income 2014 127.927 vs IFRS EFO 130.457; 2013 136.959 vs 126.379); non-operating = interest income, interest expense, equity income (0.458/0.405) and other, net (3.708/2.117) -> other_income = equity income + other, net. No cost-of-services/revenue presentation change occurred within 2013-2014 IFRS filings (2015 IFRS interims re-present 2014 quarters unchanged).

REVENUE: pre-2018 'Revenues' were all service revenue (commissions + fees), so service_rev = total_rev and inv_sales_rev/cost_inventory are NOT on the IS (net profit on inventory sales was netted inside commissions). Gross inventory sales memo (IFRS notes, USD m): revenue from inventory sales / cost of inventory sold: Q1/13 115.938/103.687, Q2/13 138.404/127.749, Q3/13 164.351/142.245, FY13 634.498/571.993 (Q4/13 = FY - published 9M 418.694/373.680 = 215.804/198.313); Q1/14 151.697/140.238, Q2/14 191.085/179.782, Q3/14 153.016/143.087, FY14 758.437/709.072 (Q4/14 by difference 262.639/245.965). Q4 commissions/fees split = FY - 9M (Q4 releases give only total revenue); all other Q4/13 and Q4/14 IFRS lines are direct three-month figures from the Q4 releases (acc 0001193125-14-079038 and 0001193125-15-065950).

NCI / EPS BASE: from the FY2013 40-F/Q4-13 release onward the company presents NI 'attributable to equity holders of the parent' (excluding 49% NCI in Ritchie Bros. Financial Services). Original Q1/13-Q3/13 releases presented total net earnings (e.g. Q1/13 14.046, 'adjusted' 14.046) - stored figures use the later restated attribution (Q1/13 NI to parent 13.989, NCI 0.057).

ADJUSTED NET EARNINGS definition: Q1/13-Q4/13 releases: 'financial statement net earnings excluding the after-tax effects of excess property sales and other non-recurring items' (base = total net earnings in Q1-Q3/13 releases, then NI to equity holders of parent from Q4/13). Q1/14-Q2/14: '...excess property sales and certain other non-recurring items'. Q3/14: '...excluding the after-tax effects of impairment losses, excess property sales and certain other items'. Q4/14: '...excluding the after-tax effects of management reorganization, impairment losses, excess property sales and certain other items' (base NI to equity holders of the parent). FY2015 10-K (US GAAP): 'Adjusted Net Income attributable to stockholders = net income attributable to stockholders excluding the after-tax effects of adjusting items'; Diluted Adjusted EPS = Adj NI / diluted shares; 10-K adds 'tax loss utilization' as an item in 2015 (none in 2013-14). Items by period: Q3/13 gain on Texas land (pre-tax 0.68, after-tax 0.415); Q4/13 Prince Rupert gain (9.203 / 6.810) and CEO separation (4.580 / 3.389); Q3/14 Narita impairment (8.084, no tax) and Grande Prairie gain (3.39 / 2.946); Q4/14 management reorganization termination benefits (5.533 / 4.212). Pre-tax values and TAX lines are reconstructed from footnotes; TAX value is a plug so items sum exactly to the published after-tax amounts. No adjusting items in Q1/13, Q2/13, Q1/14, Q2/14 (adjusted = reported).

ADJUSTED NI FY: US GAAP (10-K) 2014 100.331 / $0.93 diluted (IFRS as reported 100.840 / $0.94); 2013 89.808 / $0.84 (IFRS 89.989 / $0.84). The 10-K reconciliation shows after-tax items only; 2014 gain pre-tax taken as 3.39 (Q3/14 MD&A; 10-K table rounds to 3.4), 2013 gain pre-tax 9.88 (Q4/13 release footnote). US GAAP Q4/14 adjusted NI 35.629 / $0.33 is stored in Q4/14 'adj_ni_usgaap'.

EBITDA: IFRS-era definition (2013-2014 MD&As) = earnings from operations + depreciation + amortization (thus excludes FX, PP&E gains, impairment, other income). Q2/13-Q4/14 $ values are printed in MD&A non-GAAP reconciliations (Q1/14 in the Q1/15 MD&A); Q1/13 $ EBITDA was not printed (only 31.3% margin) - value 31.928 computed by the company's definition. 'Adjusted Operating Income' (revenues less direct and SG&A expenses excluding management reorganization / CEO separation) and 'Adjusted EBITDA' (adjusted EFO + D&A, used for Debt/Adjusted EBITDA on a 12-month basis) were introduced with the Q4/14 release; FY IFRS adj EBITDA 180.6 (2014) / 174.3 (2013). Under US GAAP (10-K) EBITDA = operating income (now incl. PP&E gains, impairment, FX) + D&A: 172.463 (2014) / 180.239 (2013), and Adjusted Operating Income additionally removes gains on excess property and impairment: 138.2 / 131.7, Adjusted EBITDA 182.8 / 175.0 - definition change between IFRS and US GAAP eras. adj_op_income_published is an extra key.

OPS: gtv = Gross Auction Proceeds (GAP; IFRS-era label), USD m. GAP from Q1/14 onward includes EquipmentOne buyers' premiums; 2013 quarterly GAP as published (and as re-presented in 2014 comparatives) EXCLUDES them (Q1/13 1.7, Q2/13 2.3, Q4/13 2.2, FY13 8.2 USD m). revenue_rate (extra key) = published revenues / GAP (fraction). Operating counts (industrial auctions only: lots_total in thousands, bidders = bidder registrations, buyers, consignments, num_auctions) are published YTD; Q2/Q3/Q4 values are YTD differences (Q4 = FY - 9M). Quarterly geographic revenue is published only as % distribution (rev_*_pct extra keys, rounded integers; US/Canada/Europe/Other by auction location); USD geographic revenue is given only for FY (IFRS 40-F note 4 and identical US GAAP 10-K table).

DPS: dps_declared by declaration date within the period: 2013 Q1 0.1225 (for Q4/12), Q2 0.1225 (declared 26-Apr-13), Q3 0.13, Q4 0.13 -> FY 0.505 (10-K table rounds to 0.51); 2014 Q1 0.13 (20-Jan-14), Q2 0.13, Q3 0.14, Q4 0.14 (declared 4-Nov-14) -> FY 0.54. Note the company's MD&A attributes each dividend to the prior quarter ('dividend for the quarter ended...'): on that basis 2013 = 0.5125, 2014 = 0.55.

BS: 2014 'bs' = US GAAP (10-K); 'bs_ifrs' = IFRS as reported (FY2014 40-F). 2013 'bs' = IFRS (FY2014 40-F comparatives) because no full US GAAP 31-Dec-2013 balance sheet was published; 'bs_usgaap_partial' holds the US GAAP 2013 figures available from the 10-K (selected data, equity statement, CF, debt/adj-EBITDA table). Mapping: prepaid expenses and deposits -> other_current; IFRS investment property (6.554 2013, 3.327 2014) added to other_noncurrent; US GAAP share unit liabilities 5.844 added to other_ncl; IFRS 'current borrowings' -> st_debt. CF: sbc = stock option compensation expense (non-cash line; total share-based payment expense incl. liability-classified share units was 10.846 in 2014, 8.266 in 2013); other_noncash = inventory write-down + equity income less dividends + unrealized FX (US GAAP) / inventory write-down + FX gain (IFRS); other_fin = finance lease repayments + other; 2013 other_investing includes 9.276 proceeds from note/loan receivable. IFRS CF shows interest paid and income taxes paid as separate operating lines (extra keys interest_paid/taxes_paid).
Units: USD millions (filings in USD thousands), shares in millions, per-share USD. Signs per spec (expenses positive; fx, gains, other income signed by income effect).
